comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, wages-single-low-hsa (3,000 code W, self-only coverage all year, no current excess) with 2,000 of excess carried in from 2024 (Form 5329 line 42) — line 43 absorbs 1,300 of it against the room under Form 8889 line 12, 700 remains on line 48, the 6% is 42; line 24 = 970.00 (928.00 with no carry-in, the assumption the service stated earlier). Re-blessed and hand-checked against Publication 969 ("Deducting an excess contribution in a later year": the lesser of the year's limit less its contributions, and the excess in the account at the start of the year): self-only limit 4,300.00 less 3,000.00 of employer contributions leaves 1,300.00, so 1,300.00 of the 2,000.00 carried in is deducted (line 11 25,000.00 -> 23,700.00; line 15 7,950.00; line 16 798.00 from the tax table) and the 6% excise falls on the 700.00 left (42.00; line 24 840.00; line 34 960.00). The 087 dictionary did not take the deduction; 089 does.
